practiceReport.name: Nnamdi Madubuike
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 70% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Madubuike was unable to play against the Panthers in Week 11 due to a hamstring injury that he sustained against the Chargers in Week 10. He would need to practice in at least a limited capacity over the next two days to have a realistic shot at playing against the Texans on Sunday.

practiceReport.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 81% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Hawkins has missed the Ravens' last five games while recovering from a knee injury, and he was not cleared to return to practice Wednesday. He would have to log at least a limited session over the next two days to have a realistic chance of playing against the Texans on Sunday.

practiceReport.name: Derrick Henry
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Mid-week Step-4 Limited non-contact participation in NFL Concussion Protocol
practiceReport.beatComment: The Ravens had previously announced that Henry cleared the five-step protocol after being checked for a concussion late in Sunday's 35-33 loss to Carolina. However, Minter noted that the running back later had "a couple of small symptoms" crop up, resulting in him being subject to the protocol as the Ravens kicked off Week 12 prep, per Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic. The fact that Henry was able to practice in some fashion Wednesday indicates that he's already cleared a couple steps of the protocol, but he'll still need to upgrade to full activity and pass neurological tests before he's officially given the green light to play Sunday.

practiceReport.name: Rashod Bateman
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (74% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: The wideout was listed with a calf injury in practice last week, so this is a new issue for Bateman. He's mostly been running wind sprints for the Ravens this season, clearing out the underneath routes for Zay Flowers and the tight ends. Bateman is averaging 2.3 catches per game for 36.6 yards with two total touchdowns across 11 contests.

practiceReport.name: Zay Flowers
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (71% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: The same applies to fellow starting WR Rashod Bateman (groin), with the duo's status now worth tracking an advance of Sunday's game against the Texans. In Baltimore's 35-33 loss to the Panthers in Week 11, Flowers was on the field for 88 percent of his team's snaps on offense, recording an 8-97-0 receiving line on a game-high 11 targets.

practiceReport.name: Mike Green
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 81%
Coaching/beat trend (beat report): trending upward / optimistic to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: Green may have tweaked his knee during the Ravens' 35-33 loss to the Panthers in Week 11, when he recorded five tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks. He'll have two more opportunities to upgrade his practice participation and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans. Green's 7.5 sacks through 11 regular-season games leads the Ravens and are 12th-most in the NFL.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jovaughn Gwyn
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: This move was anticipated after Gwyn was diagnosed with a fractured fibula earlier in the week and given a 2-to-3 month return timetable. Ethan Pocic (knee) also landed on injured reserve Saturday, so Baltimore will have to rely on rookie first-rounder Olaivavega Ioane to handle center duties Sunday versus Tennessee and for several weeks beyond.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyler Loop
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 13 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Loop emerged from Sunday's blowout loss to the Bills with a right groin injury, which will keep him out for at least the next four games. Baltimore plans to elevate or sign Jake Moody off its practice squad to take over as its kicker beginning with Thursday's game against Jacksonville. Through Baltimore's first eight contests, Loop went a perfect 18-for-18 on point-after attempts but missed four of his 17 field-goal tries.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Lamar Jackson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 13 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Last Friday, head coach Jesse Minter announced that Jackson was facing a projected recovery timeline of 6-to-10 weeks after requiring a procedure to address a broken and dislocated thumb. A Week 16 return would be right up against the short end of that timeline, so if Jackson has shown notable improvement by that point, he could push to play if the 4-6 Ravens haven't faded from the playoff picture. While Jackson remains sidelined for at least a few more weeks, the Ravens will entrust trade-deadline acquisition Jacoby Brissett to direct the offense.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ethan Pocic
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Pocic hurt his knee in Week 3 against Dallas and will need to sit out at least four games. Jovaughn Gwyn (ankle) was also moved to IR on Saturday, leaving Olaivavega Ioane to handle starting center duties for the Ravens moving forward.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Danny Pinter
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Pinter suffered a torn patella tendon in his right knee during Baltimore's joint practice with the Vikings on Aug. 19. As expected, the offensive lineman will now miss the entire 2026 campaign while on IR.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Durham Smythe
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Smythe tore his Achilles during Sunday's game versus the Titans, and he will now have to spend the remainder of the season on IR. His absence should open up more reps at tight end for rookie fourth-rounder Matthew Hibner.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jahquez Robinson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Undisclosed) on Aug 18, 2026; ineligible to return in 2026 under NFL CBA rules.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Skylar Thompson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tavius Robinson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Robinson suffered a season-ending pectoral injury during the Ravens' Week 6 loss to the Browns. The outside linebacker will spend the rest of 2026 on IR, allowing the Ravens to carry more depth on the offensive line. The team signed offensive guard Kyle Hergel from the practice squad to the active roster in a corresponding move.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyler Huntley
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Huntley and Lamar Jackson (thumb) were both placed on injured reserve Thursday. The latter still has at least a slim chance to return this season, while Huntley's injury has been confirmed to be season-ending. Joe Fagnano is set to start Thursday's game against the Jaguars before reinforcements arrive under center in the form of Jacoby Brissett, for whom the Ravens are expected to finalize a trade over the weekend.
